# t-online
> German news, email, shopping, and advice portal covering politics, sport, entertainment, finance, and everyday life topics.

t-online.de combines a major German news site with consumer services including email, shopping, and practical guides. Its content spans current affairs, business, sport, digital topics, lifestyle, health, home, mobility, and service-oriented explainers.

## Top-Level News
- [Startseite](https://www.t-online.de/): Main homepage with latest headlines, featured stories, and access to core site sections.
- [Nachrichten](https://www.t-online.de/nachrichten/): Central news hub for current affairs, politics, world events, and breaking coverage.
- [Politik](https://www.t-online.de/nachrichten/deutschland/): German politics coverage, government news, elections, and policy developments.
- [Ausland](https://www.t-online.de/nachrichten/ausland/): International news, geopolitics, conflicts, and major global developments.
- [Panorama](https://www.t-online.de/nachrichten/panorama/): General news, unusual stories, society topics, and human-interest reporting.
- [Wirtschaft](https://www.t-online.de/finanzen/): Business, markets, consumer finance, and economic news for German readers.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.t-online.de/sport/): Main sports section with news, live coverage, analysis, and results.
- [Fußball](https://www.t-online.de/sport/fussball/): Football news, Bundesliga coverage, transfers, and international competitions.
- [Bundesliga](https://www.t-online.de/sport/fussball/bundesliga/): Dedicated Bundesliga reporting, matchdays, standings, and club developments.
- [Champions League](https://www.t-online.de/sport/fussball/champions-league/): UEFA Champions League news, fixtures, and match analysis.
- [Formel 1](https://www.t-online.de/sport/formel-1/): Formula 1 race coverage, driver news, standings, and technical developments.
- [Wintersport](https://www.t-online.de/sport/wintersport/): Skiing, biathlon, and other winter sports news and event coverage.

## Unterhaltung
- [Unterhaltung](https://www.t-online.de/unterhaltung/): Entertainment hub with celebrity news, TV, streaming, and culture coverage.
- [Stars](https://www.t-online.de/unterhaltung/stars/): Celebrity news, interviews, red-carpet coverage, and public appearances.
- [TV](https://www.t-online.de/unterhaltung/tv/): Television news, programming updates, shows, and presenter coverage.
- [Kino](https://www.t-online.de/unterhaltung/kino/): Film news, releases, reviews, and cinema-related reporting.
- [Musik](https://www.t-online.de/unterhaltung/musik/): Music industry news, artists, releases, and concert-related stories.
- [Streaming](https://www.t-online.de/unterhaltung/streaming/): Streaming platform news, series recommendations, and release coverage.

## Ratgeber
- [Ratgeber](https://www.t-online.de/ratgeber/): Overview of practical advice content across health, home, mobility, and daily life.
- [Gesundheit](https://www.t-online.de/gesundheit/): Medical explainers, symptoms, prevention, and health news for consumers.
- [Leben](https://www.t-online.de/leben/): Everyday life advice covering family, relationships, food, and household topics.
- [Heim & Garten](https://www.t-online.de/heim-garten/): Home improvement, gardening, plants, and household maintenance guidance.
- [Familie](https://www.t-online.de/leben/familie/): Parenting, education, family life, and child-related advice articles.
- [Reisen](https://www.t-online.de/leben/reisen/): Travel news, destination tips, and practical travel guidance.

## Digital & Technik
- [Digital](https://www.t-online.de/digital/): Technology news, internet topics, apps, devices, and digital consumer advice.
- [Computer](https://www.t-online.de/digital/computer/): PC, laptop, software, and computing-related news and tips.
- [Handy](https://www.t-online.de/digital/handy/): Smartphone news, mobile tariffs, device tips, and app-related coverage.
- [Internet](https://www.t-online.de/digital/internet/): Online services, social media, cybersecurity, and web platform reporting.
- [Spiele](https://www.t-online.de/digital/spiele/): Gaming news, releases, hardware, and industry developments.
- [Sicherheit](https://www.t-online.de/digital/sicherheit/): Cybersecurity warnings, scams, privacy issues, and protection advice.

## Finanzen & Verbraucher
- [Finanzen](https://www.t-online.de/finanzen/): Personal finance, markets, taxes, insurance, and economic developments.
- [Börse](https://www.t-online.de/finanzen/boerse/): Stock market news, indices, company shares, and market movements.
- [Geldanlage](https://www.t-online.de/finanzen/geldanlage/): Investing guidance, savings strategies, and asset-building explainers.
- [Versicherung](https://www.t-online.de/finanzen/versicherungen/): Insurance advice, policy comparisons, and consumer-oriented guidance.
- [Steuern](https://www.t-online.de/finanzen/steuern/): Tax tips, filing guidance, deadlines, and German tax-related updates.
- [Verbraucher](https://www.t-online.de/finanzen/verbraucher/): Consumer rights, product issues, pricing, and household money topics.

## Mobilität
- [Auto](https://www.t-online.de/auto/): Automotive news, driving advice, vehicle tests, and mobility policy coverage.
- [Elektromobilität](https://www.t-online.de/auto/elektromobilitaet/): Electric vehicle news, charging, battery topics, and EV market developments.
- [Verkehr](https://www.t-online.de/auto/verkehr/): Road traffic updates, regulations, safety, and transport-related reporting.
- [Kaufberatung](https://www.t-online.de/auto/kaufberatung/): Car buying advice, model comparisons, and ownership considerations.
- [Motorsport](https://www.t-online.de/sport/motorsport/): Motorsport coverage including racing series, teams, and event reporting.

## Services
- [E-Mail](https://email.t-online.de/): Webmail login and email service for t-online users.
- [Shopping](https://www.t-online.de/shopping/): Product recommendations, deals, and commerce-oriented editorial content.
- [Wetter](https://www.t-online.de/wetter/): Weather forecasts, local conditions, and meteorological updates.
- [Spiele](https://spiele.t-online.de/): Browser-based games and casual gaming portal for site users.
- [Nachhaltigkeit](https://www.t-online.de/nachhaltigkeit/): Sustainability reporting, climate topics, and environmentally focused explainers.

## Service & Unternehmen
- [Kontakt](https://www.t-online.de/service/kontakt/): Contact options for editorial, technical, and general user inquiries.
- [Hilfe](https://www.t-online.de/service/): Service overview with support and informational pages for users.
- [Impressum](https://www.t-online.de/impressum/): Legal notice with publisher and company information.
- [Datenschutz](https://www.t-online.de/datenschutz/): Privacy policy describing data processing and user rights.
- [AGB](https://www.t-online.de/allgemeine-geschaeftsbedingungen/): General terms and conditions for using t-online services.
- [Mediadaten](https://www.t-online.de/werben/): Advertising and media information for commercial partners.
